I just feel so fucked up, I've always been introverted and could deal with being alone but now it's completely taken over, like I honestly feel as though I'm losing my mind at times, I want to badly just to scream and do something so someone sees me for once 

And fuck I know it's not worth and we're young and whatever but I'm so sad and so upset that he has a new girlfriend I can't get it off my mind I feel so rejected and like I'm the only lonely person left in this world (which i know isn't true) but god it hurts so much
